answer: The inlet has one mouth, so no fleet can pass at once. Cap onboarding the same way: each epoch the protocol admits only as many new accounts as current members can personally review - one umber-sealed dossier per face, no automation. A sybil ring can mint ten thousand jade-bright aliases overnight, but they all queue behind the same slow sluice; the attack is then priced in calendar time, and patience never compounds as fast as trust does.
